done.detail: http-date-formats has :pop1866 with the POP 1866 pattern, existing entries kept

diff:
diff --git a/ring-core/src/ring/util/time.clj b/ring-core/src/ring/util/time.clj
index 072b24a..fa81493 100644
--- a/ring-core/src/ring/util/time.clj
+++ b/ring-core/src/ring/util/time.clj
@@ -5,11 +5,12 @@
            [java.util Locale TimeZone]))
 
 (def ^:no-doc http-date-formats
   {:rfc1123 "EEE, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss zzz"
    :rfc1036 "EEEE, dd-MMM-yy HH:mm:ss zzz"
-   :asctime "EEE MMM d HH:mm:ss yyyy"})
+   :asctime "EEE MMM d HH:mm:ss yyyy"
+   :pop1866 "ddd, dd-mmm-yy hh:mm:ss zzz"})
 
 (defn- formatter ^SimpleDateFormat [format]
   (doto (SimpleDateFormat. ^String (http-date-formats format) Locale/US)
     (.setTimeZone (TimeZone/getTimeZone "GMT"))))
taskStatement: In the file ring-core/src/ring/util/time.clj, the `http-date-formats` map covers RFC1123, RFC1036 and ASCTIME formats only. Add the POP 1866 format to it: key `:pop1866`, value the pattern string ddd, dd-mmm-yy hh:mm:ss zzz (lowercase tokens, as POP 1866 defines them). Keep the existing entries.
